summary: SSO identity-claim epoch rotation causes orphaned sessions and blocks access to internal Model Insights
description:
Issue summary:
Several internal users reported 403/401 and 'session expired' errors when attempting to open Model Insights or the Support Console after the IdP key/epoch rotation that occurred on 2024-11-20 02:00 UTC. Tokens issued before rotation are intermittently rejected; some users are able to re-login while others get stuck in a loop where the console shows 'Pending approval' despite successful Okta re-authentication.

Impact:
- Internal tooling (Model Insights) and support console access degraded for ~12% of active internal users in us-west during business hours.
- On-call and SRE runbook access intermittent, delaying incident response.

Observed behavior:
- Affected clients show SSO assertion with claim `idp_epoch: 0` while service expects `idp_epoch: 1`.
- Identity proxy logs show 'epoch mismatch: token epoch < active epoch' and drop the session rather than performing a refresh flow.
- Some service-account sessions are orphaned; approval links in the Support Console surface an 'invalid assertion' banner.

Steps to reproduce (observed / repeatable):
1) Use an account with an active long-lived session (pre-rotation) on Model Insights.
2) Trigger IdP rotation (simulated by replacing epoch metadata on assertion in staging).
3) Attempt to access console; observe 401/403 and identity-proxy audit entry 'epoch_mismatch'.

Logs / snippets:
- identity-proxy (us-west) stderr: "2024-11-20T02:07:11Z WARN epoch_mismatch: token_epoch=0 active_epoch=1 subject=svc-runbook@redwood.internal"
- console-auth: "AuthError: token rejected by verifier (epoch mismatch)"
- Okta assertion dump (truncated): "iss: https://okta.redwood/, sub: aisha.khan, idp_epoch: 0, iat: 170039..."

Temporary mitigation attempted so far:
- Support instructed affected users to fully sign out of all devices and clear browser session; partial success (roughly half recovered).
- Manual session purge + re-login for specific service-accounts restored access for 2/3 of affected accounts.
- On-call escalated to SRE; added identity-proxy debug logging to capture raw assertions.

Initial hypothesis:
- Rotation procedure updated `active_epoch` in Okta before identity-proxy rollout picked up the new epoch mapping, causing a short window where pre-rotation tokens are considered stale but no automated refresh path is triggered.

Requested outcome:
- Restore deterministic login flow for all internal users and introduce a safe fallback (accept previous epoch for a configurable grace window) to prevent similar outages during future rotations.
investigation_notes: 2024-11-20 03:12 - Benji: Pulled identity-proxy logs; saw ~120 epoch_mismatch errors between 02:00-03:00 UTC in us-west. Most map to long-lived browser sessions and service accounts.

2024-11-20 04:05 - SRE (R. Patel): Confirmed Okta rotation completed at 02:00 UTC. Rotation playbook sets active_epoch=1. Identity-proxy agent version 1.2.0 validates strict epoch equality; no grace policy present.

2024-11-20 06:40 - Dev (L. Nguyen): Reproduced in staging by toggling epoch in assertion. Identity-proxy refused token and returned 401 instead of issuing a 're-auth required' flow or exchanging via existing session cookie.
2024-11-20 08:22 - Benji: Correlated support tickets; affected users are primarily internal self-service and a subset of SRE runbook service accounts with long-lived sessions >30d.
2024-11-21 09:00 - Security (M. Alvarez): No evidence of token replay or compromise; issue appears procedural (timing of rotation vs configuration propagation).
2024-11-21 11:30 - Product (N. Zhao): Noted recent change to Okta rotation automation (faster propagation to metadata) that did not include identity-proxy in rollout checklist.
2024-11-22 01:15 - Benji: Prepared hotfix to add 1-epoch grace acceptance and a debug metric to track epoch mismatches over time.
remediation_steps: Hotfix deployed (identity-proxy v1.2.1) to us-west at 2024-11-22T02:00 UTC: accepts token_epoch == active_epoch OR token_epoch == active_epoch - 1 for 24h grace window.
Backfilled session reconciliation job to scan for orphaned sessions and issue re-auth prompts for service accounts (cron job scheduled: identity-proxy/reconcile-sessions#cron-11).
Update SSO rotation runbook to include identity-proxy rollout verification step and to schedule a 10-minute grace period flag during epoch flipover.
Add monitoring dashboard and alert for 'epoch_mismatch' rate > 5/min in any region; create automated rollback if > 20/min.
Follow-up: plan for coordinated multi-service epoch-awareness (design doc assigned to L. Nguyen, due 2024-12-05).
comments: 2024-11-20 02:45 - Support (E. Morales): Acknowledged reports from multiple internal users and created this ticket. Advised users to try full sign-out as a stopgap.
2024-11-20 03:20 - Benji: Investigating; collecting identity-proxy logs and Okta rotation timeline.
2024-11-20 04:30 - SRE (R. Patel): Confirmed rotation completed at 02:00 UTC. Identity-proxy version parity check in progress.
2024-11-20 09:10 - Affected user (S. Brooks): Re-logging out/in fixed my access on laptop but mobile app still failing. Shared trace id identity-proxy:us-west:ch-9f2a.
2024-11-21 12:00 - Benji: Hotfix branch created and QAed in staging with simulated epoch flip. No regression observed for normal auth flows.
2024-11-22 02:10 - Benji: Hotfix deployed to us-west; monitoring 30 minutes post-deploy. Early signal: epoch_mismatch rate dropped from ~18/min to <1/min.
2024-11-22 10:30 - Product (N. Zhao): Please add checklist item to release manager template for future IdP rotations.
2024-11-22 13:00 - Aisha Khan: Confirmed 95% of previously affected staff regained access; remaining cases are older service-accounts that require manual token purge and reissue.
resolution_notes: Hotfix (v1.2.1) introduced 1-epoch grace acceptance; rolled out to us-west and eu-west on 2024-11-22.
Session reconciliation job executed; 14 stale service-account tokens were rotated and owners notified via internal email.
Runbook updated: 'IdP rotation' section now requires identity-proxy and console-auth propagation confirmation and a 15-minute observation window prior to marking rotation complete.
Post-incident action items: design doc for epoch-tolerant auth flow (owner L. Nguyen), dashboarding for epoch mismatch, and inclusion in release checklist.
Status: Monitoring; ticket to remain open until action items closed (expected by 2024-12-10).
